summary.zh-CN: 指导把需要在本机运行的 MCP 服务器连同运行时打包成单个 .mcpb 文件：编写 manifest.json 清单、Node 或 Python 构建流程、本地安全清单，以及校验、打包与签名命令。
summary.en: Guides packaging a local MCP server together with its runtime into a single .mcpb file: writing the manifest.json file, Node or Python build pipelines, a local security checklist, and validate, pack and sign commands.

conditions.zh-CN: Teloa 本身不安装 .mcpb 文件；npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb 等命令由用户在自己的终端执行，打包结果面向支持 MCPB 的客户端应用
conditions.en: Teloa itself does not install .mcpb files; commands such as npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb run in the user's own terminal, and the bundle targets client apps that support MCPB

conditions.zh-CN: 正文提到的 build-mcp-server、build-mcp-app 技能不随本资源提供；构建远端 MCP 服务器可参考 MCP 服务器构建指南（anthropic.mcp-builder）
conditions.en: The build-mcp-server and build-mcp-app skills mentioned in the text are not included; for remote MCP servers see the MCP server builder (anthropic.mcp-builder)

conditions.zh-CN: 许可为原始仓库根目录的 LICENSE（Apache-2.0），不在技能目录内
conditions.en: The license is the LICENSE (Apache-2.0) at the root of the original repository, outside the skill directory
